items.tap: some orange rencate hand claws with hooked tips

items.name: a diamond and platinum necklace with suspended stormfire topaz globular pendants
items.tap: a diamond and platinum necklace with suspended stormfire topaz globular pendants

items.name: a dull tin sieve with cracked handles

items.name: a fashionable sunfire faille cloak with intricate Elven gold clasps

Extravagant use of sunfire fibers causes the textile to appear to have a rippling mirage of sunlight running across the surface much like late afternoon sunbeams playing across a placid lake.  The illusion is further amplified by the occasional use of metallic golden filaments to highlight the fabric's ribbing.

items.name: a fragile faesilk gem pouch dangling sungold key charms

items.name: a green dragonar satchel with a large heliotrope clasp

A grinning goblin's face forms the dark iron clasp.

items.name: a ka'hurst hide scraper etched with evergreen trees

items.tap: a knee-length voidfrost brocade skirt with a narrow ruffle around the hem

items.name: a kuwinite wristlet with broad engraved links

items.tap: a lacquered rowan crossbow with a silversteel prod

items.name: a thunder of pewter dragons displaying multihued wings

items.name: a winterweave meshor fox with glacier emerald eyes
